Beks' Taco Seasoning
By: The Eggless Tort
Published: Thursday, September 2, 2010 - 11:38am

Ingredients




2 tablespoons chili powder
1 1/2 tablespoons cumin
1 1/2 tablespoons paprika
1 tablespoon onion powder or dehydrated onion
1 tablespoon garlic powder or dehydrated garlic
1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper (depending on the amount of heat you like)

Preparation

1 Combine all of the ingredients and blend well. Store in an airtight container. 2 tbsp. of this mixture will season 1 lb. of meat/meat substitute.
